{{Top|leg}}
The '''Endor Run''' was the name of a ploy used by [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]] and [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]. It involved disguising oneself and infiltrating a location posing as someone who was supposed to be there. The name alluded to the Heroes of the Rebellion's landing on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Cryle Cavv]] proposed using the tactic to infiltrate the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].<ref name="TFO">{{JournalCite|15|Two for One}}</ref>
